name: Parc Bistro-Brasserie
notes: Restaurant's own site (SpotHopper-hosted), server-rendered, plain curl. All eight menu tabs (Lunch, Brunch, Dinner, Wine, Cocktails, Beer, Happy Hour Menu, Desserts) are present in one page's HTML, not client-fetched, so nothing was missed to tab-gating. Section names prefixed with menu name since some dishes/prices repeat across menus (e.g. Caviar Service appears on Lunch/Brunch/Dinner at the same $130/oz). Excluded a back-bar spirits reference nested under the Desserts tab (Port, Les Digestive, Cordials/Brandy, Scotch, Whiskey/Bourbon, Tequila sections) as an adjunct liquor list, not food menu content. Kept Dessert Wines/Dessert Cocktails/Desserts Menu as core. Prices with a unit suffix (/Glass, /1 oz, /1 Liter) had the unit folded into the dish name and the bare dollar figure used as price. No markup pattern (own site, not an ordering platform) — prices cluster on whole/half dollars typical of fine dining.
